hints.title: Independent Interval Equilibrium
hints.text: Examine contiguous segments of unfallen dominoes flanked by directional boundary forces.

hints.title: Virtual Boundary Padding
hints.text: Wrap the dominoes string with L on the left and R on the right to handle edge intervals uniformly.

hints.title: Four Boundary Interactions
hints.text: Between boundary i and j: if LL, all fall left; if RR, all fall right; if LR, all remain standing; if RL, two pointers meet in center.

complexity.notes: Two-pointer interval resolution with sentinel boundaries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating state second-by-second takes O(N^2) time for long standing chains.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: List of character chunks produces final string in O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use sentinel boundaries to handle string ends without branching edge cases.
